stem: Which practices improve the scientific value of a cannabis morphology record? Select all that apply.
choices: Record chronology separately from observed developmental state
Use stable plant, crop, room, or batch identifiers
Document uncertain structures as uncertain and schedule follow-up observation
Replace direct observations with the most likely diagnosis
Compare repeated observations using consistent anatomical locations
rationale: Traceability, separation of chronology from morphology, explicit uncertainty, and repeated comparable observations make records reproducible. A suspected diagnosis should not replace the original evidence.
